prompts.sentence: I ___ live in Madrid, but I'm moving next year.
prompts.explain: "Actualmente" (en este momento) es currently. Actually significa "en realidad".

prompts.sentence: It looks expensive, but it's ___ quite cheap.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí corresponde actually: corrige una impresión equivocada.

prompts.sentence: She's six months ___ and due in April.
prompts.explain: Embarazada es pregnant. Embarrassed significa avergonzado.

prompts.sentence: I was so ___ when I forgot his name.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es embarrassed: sentir vergüenza.

prompts.sentence: The team will ___ the study over three months.
prompts.explain: "Realizar" un trabajo es carry out o perform. Realize es darse cuenta.

prompts.sentence: I didn't ___ how late it was.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es realize: darse cuenta de algo.

prompts.sentence: Will you ___ the meeting on Friday?
prompts.explain: Asistir a un evento es attend. Assist significa ayudar.

prompts.sentence: A nurse will ___ the doctor during surgery.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es assist: prestar ayuda.

entries.note: Assist existe en español como "asistir a alguien" (ayudar). El error es usarlo para eventos.

prompts.sentence: He's very ___ and cries during movies.
prompts.explain: Sensible (emocional) es sensitive. Sensible en inglés es sensato.

prompts.sentence: Buying insurance was a ___ decision.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es sensible: una decisión sensata.

prompts.sentence: We might ___ need a bigger office, but nothing is decided.
prompts.explain: "Eventualmente" (tal vez) es possibly. Eventually significa finalmente.

prompts.sentence: After years of trying, she ___ got the job.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es eventually: ocurrió al final, tras un proceso.

prompts.sentence: I can't ___ his constant complaining.
prompts.explain: Soportar algo molesto es put up with o stand. Support es apoyar.

prompts.sentence: My family always ___ my decisions.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es support: dar apoyo.

prompts.sentence: A waiter will ___ you shortly.
prompts.explain: Atender a un cliente es serve o help. Attend es asistir a un evento.

prompts.sentence: Three hundred people will ___ the conference.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es attend: estar presente en un evento.

prompts.sentence: Save the file in the shared ___.
prompts.explain: Carpeta es folder. Carpet es alfombra.

prompts.sentence: They put a red ___ on the floor.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es carpet: una alfombra.

prompts.sentence: I bought this novel at a ___ downtown.
prompts.explain: Librería (donde se compra) es bookstore. Library es biblioteca.

prompts.sentence: You can borrow the book from the ___ for free.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es library: se presta, no se vende.

prompts.sentence: I can't stop sneezing — I ___.
prompts.explain: Estar constipado (resfriado) es to have a cold. Constipated es estreñido.

prompts.sentence: The product launch was a huge ___.
prompts.explain: Éxito es success. Exit es la salida.

prompts.sentence: Please use the emergency ___ at the back.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es exit: la puerta de salida.

prompts.sentence: What is the ___ version of the app?
prompts.explain: La versión actual es the current version. Actual significa real.

prompts.sentence: The ___ cost was higher than the estimate.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es actual: el coste real, no el estimado.

prompts.sentence: We ___ to finish the project by June.
prompts.explain: Pretender (tener intención) es intend o aim. Pretend es fingir.

prompts.sentence: The kids like to ___ they're astronauts.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es pretend: fingir, jugar a ser.

prompts.sentence: They started to ___ loudly and someone left the room.
prompts.explain: Discutir con enfado es argue. Discuss es tratar un tema.

prompts.sentence: Let's ___ the budget at tomorrow's meeting.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es discuss: hablar del tema, sin conflicto.

entries.note: Discuss nunca lleva about: "discuss the budget", no "discuss about the budget".

prompts.sentence: The label carries a health ___ about sugar.
prompts.explain: Advertencia es warning. Advertisement es un anuncio.

prompts.sentence: I saw an ___ for the concert online.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es advertisement: publicidad.

prompts.sentence: I can't ___ where I parked the car.
prompts.explain: Recordar es remember. Record es grabar o registrar.

prompts.sentence: They will ___ the meeting so we can watch it later.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es record: grabar.

prompts.sentence: The meeting was very ___ — almost three hours.
prompts.explain: Largo (duración o longitud) es long. Large es grande.

prompts.sentence: Can I get a ___ coffee, please?
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es large: tamaño grande.

prompts.sentence: Sorry to ___ you, but do you have a minute?
prompts.explain: Molestar es bother o disturb. Molest tiene un significado grave y sexual: nunca lo uses así.

entries.note: Error de alto riesgo social. Molest solo aparece en contextos de delito sexual.

prompts.sentence: Joining the team is a long-term ___.
prompts.explain: Compromiso (obligación asumida) es commitment. Compromise es ceder para llegar a un acuerdo.

prompts.sentence: After hours of talks, both sides reached a ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es compromise: cada parte cedió algo.

prompts.sentence: Could you ___ the report in two paragraphs?
prompts.explain: Resumir es summarize. Resume significa reanudar algo interrumpido.

prompts.sentence: The match will ___ after the rain stops.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es resume: continuar tras una pausa.

entries.note: El sustantivo résumé (con acentos) es el CV en inglés americano.

prompts.sentence: Please ___ the old files from the folder.
prompts.explain: Quitar algo es remove o take away. Quit es abandonar o renunciar.

prompts.sentence: He decided to ___ his job and travel.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es quit: dejar el trabajo.

prompts.sentence: I need to wash my ___ this weekend.
prompts.explain: Ropa es clothes. Rope es una cuerda.

prompts.sentence: Everyone likes her — she's so friendly and ___.
prompts.explain: Simpático (agradable) es nice o friendly. Sympathetic es comprensivo ante un problema.

prompts.sentence: She was very ___ when I told her about the accident.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es sympathetic: mostró comprensión ante algo malo.

prompts.sentence: She studied a five-year ___ in architecture.
prompts.explain: La carrera que se estudia es a degree. Career es la trayectoria profesional.

prompts.sentence: He built a successful ___ in journalism.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es career: la vida profesional.
